name: neural-alpha
description: Neural Alpha — public multi-tenant platform for autonomous BSC trading agents

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n feed,supervisor,dashboard -c green,magenta,cyan "npm run market-feed --workspace=neural-alpha" "npm run dev --workspace=@neural-alpha/supervisor" "npm run dev --workspace=dashboard"
scripts.dev:all:legacy: concurrently -n feed,agent,dashboard -c green,yellow,cyan "npm run market-feed --workspace=neural-alpha" "MARKET_FEED_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4100 npm run dev --workspace=neural-alpha" "npm run dev --workspace=dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=neural-alpha && npm run build --workspace=dashboard
